extension.description: Enjoy TFC's Pinoy TV shows, movies, news and live channels! This is not an official TFC.tv addon. A subscription to TFC.tv website (http://tfc.tv) is required to enjoy TFC's catalog. iWantTFC Kodi uses Trakt but is not endorsed or certified by Trakt.
extension.news:
v3.10.0 [new] Skip Intro and Skip Recap: when iWant marks the intro or the recap of an episode, a button appears on the video (or the add-on skips it by itself, see the Playback settings) [change] Up Next offers the next episode when the credits start
v3.9.0 [new] Live TV in the main menu: the live channels, then the live events, of your country [fix] The log no longer holds your tokens, cookies or passwords [fix] A title iWant refuses (GMA ones) stays in My List of Kodi only, with a message [fix] Actions started from a menu entry (Tools, login) end properly: no more error in the Kodi log [fix] An expired login is renewed for every call to the website: no more empty lists after a few days without signing in again
